about: I am Yakupha Ntonintshi, an aspiring fullstack developer. I went to COSAT high school where I was introduced in the basics of the computer. My journey started with a curiosity for how things work on the web, which quickly turned into a love for coding and solving real-world problems through technology. With a solid foundation in both front-end and back-end development, I strive to build seamless, scalable web applications that offer great user experiences and robust functionality. I am constantly learning and adapting to new technologies and frameworks to stay on the cutting edge of web development.

Her attention to detail and commitment to excellence is apparent in every aspect of her work. Yakupha is a true professional who cares deeply about their clients' success. We couldn't be happier with our new site.

testimonials.review: From the start, Yakupha stood out for her creativity, technical proficiency, and dedication to client satisfaction. She took our ideas and turned them into a dynamic website that has significantly enhanced our online presence.
